about: Per-game env defaults for games on the Mali system driver (Blobferry bridge), read by droiddeck-mali-defaults at every game start. Keys: steam:<app id> or <store>:<store id> (never a per-install Steam shortcut id). Only env and env2 (the few names older apps refuse, applied after env by v0.3.2 and later) apply; pending entries are documented candidates and are never applied. The user's own game settings and shared settings always win key by key; BL_MALI_GAME_DEFAULTS=0 turns all of it off. Every game's global D3D12 defaults come from the app (GameEnvironment.defaults: VKD3D_FEATURE_LEVEL=12_1, VKD3D_SHADER_MODEL=6_6, no VKD3D_CONFIG, no GPU vendor spoof, no nvapi); an entry here only adds what that game needs to start or a measured winner (docs/agents/env-defaults-1106.md).

epic:Calluna.note: tested on the game's Low preset (renderer.ini); the app does not change game settings

Needs compat layer 3f7cf69cb5dc47af204835750cf55486 or later with FB_MASK; layers without it ignore the key. The built-in MALI_COMPAT_PASS_ORDER (56b84037) was reverted on bridge main (c1de5b2) after passorder-1106 L1, so the key stays. 2026.11.19.1: FEX_VECTORTSOENABLED=1 (the boot-freeze fix): without strict TSO 3 of 5 boots froze; control-bootfreeze-1113 (11-13) HOLD 6/6 clean boots with all three strict-TSO keys, control-tsobisect-1113 (11-13 14:34) VEC-ONLY 5/5 clean at 36.9 fps standing, +1-2 fps against all three (control.md l.6 and l.9); the user chose the vector key alone as the default (11-13 16:0x). The phone still runs all three (phone env snapshot bridge/build/debug-update-1119/R4/ea-now.json (2026-11-19 19:00, md5 b50526c2); release-gate-1115 R1 PASS, control.md l.49), so the other two stay pending.

steam:292030.title: The Witcher 3

env.DXVK_CONFIG: d3d11.maxTessFactor = 1; d3d11.samplerAnisotropy = 1; d3d11.invariantPosition = True; d3d11.relaxedBarriers = True; dxvk.numCompilerThreads = 4

steam:292030.evidence: DX11 keys: the 11-01 pack + threads dxvk-cs,MainThread + its DXVK_CONFIG (defaults.md § 2, witcher3.md). VKD3D_CONFIG=nodxr (DX12 build only; vkd3d ignores it under DX11): on the phone's 292030 entry in every DX12 run since the 11-05 12:46 switch (witcher3.md l.383; w3-uncap, w3-towncpu, witcher-fbnarrow), not A/B-tested alone. FEX_EXTENDEDVOLATILEMETADATA (the town loop ranges of witcher3.exe, so FEX keeps TSO-off code there): witcher-tsofix-1106 L2 (11-06 11:45-12:00), RenderThread 88.3 -> 58.0 Mcyc/frame (-34 %), STAND 33.1 fps uncapped, 0 major flashes; witcher3.md l.768-777. Env only, works with the shipped FEX DLL a2448b03. MALI_COMPAT_FB_MASK=0x0d6 (the DX12 terrain-flash fix): witcher-fbnarrow 11-05, 0 major flashes in 600 s (P 0.012), cost -0.5 % fps / +3.4 GPU-busy points at the 30 cap; kept on the phone's 292030 entry (winner rule, HANDOFF 11-06 11:32). Needs compat layer 3f7cf69cb5dc47af204835750cf55486 or later with FB_MASK (de6e975d ignores it). Open: passorder-1106 L1 saw 4 major flashes in the first daylight clip with the same 0x0d6 mask built in (HANDOFF 11-06 13:50); the built-in was reverted (bridge c1de5b2), so the key stays until the daylight case is understood. 2026.11.19.1 adds two winners that were only on the phone (phone env snapshot bridge/build/debug-update-1119/R4/ea-now.json (2026-11-19 19:00, md5 b50526c2)): FEX_HOSTFEATURES=disableafp (11-07 lever 1, WINNER: fps 30.0 -> 34.9 mean, RenderThread 31.6 -> 26.2 ms/frame, user: looks good; witcher3.md l.8, witcher3-archive.md l.837 and l.1005; this game only, it breaks Watch Dogs and Watch Dogs 2). MALI_COMPAT_FAKE_LIMITS=1 (integ-night-1111 rev 2, 2026-11-11 02:56, AB WIN ratio 1.000, 0 FATAL; witcher3.md l.9 and l.57): every DX12 and ray tracing measurement since then ran with it, so the app's DXR switch (BL_DXR) meets the limits it was measured with; with ray tracing off it is harmless: w3-rt-1116 (11-16 07:54) RT OFF 38.6 fps and release-gate-1115 R5 (11-15 20:13) RT OFF PASS, both with the key, on layer 94dcc32d. Ray tracing stays off: VKD3D_CONFIG stays nodxr and no RT key is set here (MALI_COMPAT_RT_PIPELINE comes from BL_DXR, MALI_COMPAT_RT_SIZE_PAD=0 is the layer's default). GAMESCOPE_WSI_FRAME_LIMITER_AWARE=0 (the warning-screen freeze fix, witcher3.md l.9) is a winner too, but this schema does not allow that name.

steam:782330.title: DOOM Eternal
steam:782330.note: reports the GPU as NVIDIA (RTX 2080) to this game only: its launcher accepts NVIDIA/AMD/Intel GPUs only
steam:782330.evidence: needed to start: idTechLauncher.exe stops with RGL_VALIDATION_ERROR_VENDOR_NOT_RECOGNIZED: 4 on Arm's 0x13b5; with MALI_COMPAT_VENDOR_ID=10de DOOMEternalx64vk.exe starts (doom_eternal.md l.7). The RTX 2080 device id/name is the compat layer's default for 10de. MALI_COMPAT_FAKE_LIMITS=1 (11-07): the layer's limit overrides are opt-in since 11-07; DOOM needs them to get past its engine asserts (doom_eternal.md l.7 'start asserts'). 2026.11.19.1 adds two winners that were only on the phone: MALI_COMPAT_DESC_POOL_SCALE=8 (run dd1106, 2026-11-06 21:29, verdict WIN: title screen reached, the 0x141C18809 crash gone; the vendor driver enforces descriptor pool counts) and MALI_COMPAT_BDA_EXT=1 (run doom-gfx-1112, 2026-11-12, H-BDA CONFIRM: 74631 BC decodes, the textures appear; doom_eternal.md l.7 'winner 11-12' and l.9; needs a compat layer with BDA_EXT, Blobferry 0.3.0 or later, older layers ignore it). Both on the phone's 782330 entry in the release gate on layer 94dcc32d; phone env snapshot bridge/build/debug-update-1119/R4/ea-now.json (2026-11-19 19:00, md5 b50526c2). Left out: MALI_WSI_FPS and MALI_COMPAT_FAIL_LOG (diagnostics).
